Story: As a clerk, I create a taxpayer with a mobile, so I can bill them later.
AC-1 Created message · AC-2 Shows in My data · AC-3 Spaces removed · AC-4 Duplicate mobile refused · AC-5 Name rules · AC-6 Email rules · AC-7 Only my name-tag sees it · AC-8 Mobile rules

children.note:
Card 01 · TRN-01 · Register a taxpayer
Story: As a clerk, I create a taxpayer with a mobile, so I can bill them later.
AC-1 Section "1 — Create a taxpayer" shows [full name] created — mobile [mobile].
AC-2 The same taxpayer details show under My data › My taxpayers.
AC-3 Spaces around the name are removed, both in the "created" message and in My data.
AC-4 A mobile that's already registered is not accepted. Message: already registered for this tenant
AC-5 Name accepts only 2–100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ. Message: 2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only
AC-6 Email is optional. If typed, it needs one @ with a dot after it, 254 characters max. Message: invalid email format
AC-7 A taxpayer created under my name-tag shows only for that name-tag. Under another name-tag, My data shows "None yet — create one in Training setup." and the Taxpayer lists are empty.
AC-8 Mobile accepts only 09 + 9 digits, or +639 + 9 digits. No spaces, no dashes. Message: must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX
Example: POST /api/v1/training/taxpayers {"full_name":"Ana Dela Cruz","mobile":"09013724603"} → 201 {"taxpayer_id":"d55f5627-…","full_name":"Ana Dela Cruz","mobile":"09013724603","email":null,"created_at":"2026-11-02T18:22:04.959Z"}
List: GET /api/v1/training/taxpayers → 200 [ {taxpayer_id, tenant_id, full_name, mobile, email, created_by, created_at}, … ]

children.text: Training setup › 1 — Create a taxpayer
1. Upon page load

W1 · AC-1 · open the Create a taxpayer form: all boxes empty, no result box
Steps: Home › button "Create my data" › (nothing else)
→ On screen: heading "1 — Create a taxpayer"; empty boxes Full name, Mobile (09XXXXXXXXX), Email (optional); button "Create taxpayer"; no result box
2. Element validations (one rule per node)
AC-5 · Name

W6 · AC-5 · refuse the full name "A" (1 letter) on the screen
Steps: Home › button "Create my data" › Full name "A", Mobile <new mobile> › button "Create taxpayer"
→ On screen: under Full name: "2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only"; no result box
AC-8 · Mobile

W8 · AC-8 · refuse the mobile 0917-123-4567 (dashes) on the screen
Steps: Home › button "Create my data" › Full name "Ana Dela Cruz", Mobile "0917-123-4567" › button "Create taxpayer"
→ On screen: under Mobile (09XXXXXXXXX): "must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX"; no result box
AC-6 · Email (optional)

W7 · AC-6 · refuse the email "rosa@examplecom" (no dot after @) on the screen
Steps: Home › button "Create my data" › Full name "Ana Dela Cruz", Mobile <new mobile>, Email "rosa@examplecom" › button "Create taxpayer"
→ On screen: under Email (optional): "invalid email format"; no result box
Only the first broken rule shows (order: name, mobile, email). Try name "A" and mobile "0917": only the name message.
3. Functional validations

W2 · AC-1 · create a taxpayer on the screen using "Ana Dela Cruz" and a new mobile
Steps: Home › button "Create my data" › Full name "Ana Dela Cruz", Mobile <new mobile> › button "Create taxpayer"
→ On screen: "Ana Dela Cruz created — mobile <new mobile>."

W4 · AC-3 · create a taxpayer using "  Rosa Web  ": shown as "Rosa Web"
Steps: Home › button "Create my data" › Full name "  Rosa Web  ", Mobile <new mobile> › button "Create taxpayer" › top bar link "My data"
→ On screen: "Rosa Web created — mobile <new mobile>."; My taxpayers row starts "Rosa Web"

W5 · AC-4 · refuse the same mobile twice on the screen ("Ben Dela Cruz" after "Ana Dela Cruz")
Steps: Home › button "Create my data" › create a taxpayer with <new mobile> › reload › create another with the same mobile
→ On screen: under Mobile (09XXXXXXXXX): "already registered for this tenant"
My data › My taxpayers (where you check it)

A3 · AC-2 · find the taxpayer from A1 in my list (created_by = my name-tag)
GET /api/v1/training/taxpayers
→ 200, a row with the same taxpayer_id, full_name, mobile, and created_by = my name-tag

W3 · AC-2 · see the new taxpayer "Ana Dela Cruz" in My data
Steps: Home › button "Create my data" › create "Ana Dela Cruz" with <new mobile> › top bar link "My data"
→ On screen: row Ana Dela Cruz | <new mobile> | —

W9 · AC-7 · show nothing to another name-tag ("Probe") in My data
Steps: top bar link "Change" › type a new name (e.g. "Probe") › button "Save" › top bar link "My data"
→ On screen: under My taxpayers: "None yet — create one in Training setup."

A32 · AC-7 · leave my taxpayer out of another user's list (X-User-ID <me>-probe)
GET /api/v1/training/taxpayers with X-User-ID: <me>-probe
→ 200, and my taxpayer_id is not in it
Integration: the API and the screen agree

I1 · AC-1, AC-2 · create "Ana Dela Cruz" with the API, see it on the screen
POST /api/v1/training/taxpayers {"full_name":"Ana Dela Cruz","mobile":"<new mobile>","email":"rosa@example.com"} › screen: top bar link "My data"
→ row Ana Dela Cruz | <new mobile> | rosa@example.com

I2 · AC-1, AC-3 · create "  Rosa Web  " on the screen, read "Rosa Web" from the API
Steps: Home › button "Create my data" › Full name "  Rosa Web  ", Mobile <new mobile> › button "Create taxpayer" › GET /api/v1/training/taxpayers
→ a row full_name "Rosa Web", mobile <new mobile>, email null, created_by = my name-tag

I3 · AC-5, AC-6, AC-8 · show the same message on the API and the screen for name "A", mobile "0917-123-4567" and email "rosa@examplecom"
For name "A", mobile "0917-123-4567", email "rosa@examplecom": send it to the API, then type it on the screen
→ the text under the field on the screen = the API's detail message, word for word

I4 · AC-5, AC-8 · accept on the screen what the API accepts ("Ñoño O'Brien-Cruz Jr.", +639 mobile)
Steps: Home › button "Create my data" › Full name "Ñoño O'Brien-Cruz Jr.", Mobile "+639<9 new digits>" › button "Create taxpayer"
→ "Ñoño O'Brien-Cruz Jr. created — mobile 09<the same 9 digits>." (the 09 form the API stores)

I5 · AC-4 · refuse on the screen a mobile the API registered
POST /api/v1/training/taxpayers with <new mobile> › Steps: Home › button "Create my data" › Full name "Ben Dela Cruz", the same mobile › button "Create taxpayer"
→ under Mobile (09XXXXXXXXX): "already registered for this tenant"

I6 · AC-7 · use the same name-tag on the screen and the API (a probe user's taxpayer stays hidden)
POST /api/v1/training/taxpayers as X-User-ID <me>-probe with mobile A, and as me with mobile B › screen as me: top bar link "My data"
→ a row with mobile B; no row with mobile A
Questions for the BA (not failures)
AC-4 vs AC-7: another name-tag can't see my taxpayer but can't register its mobile either. Intended?
Anyone who types my whole name-tag sees my data. Is that what the city wants?
DevTools: the Network tab shows X-User-ID = the top-bar name-tag on the taxpayers request
Risk: a wrong mobile means the taxpayer can't be found; a duplicate splits one person's bills; a shared name-tag leaks data; screen and API rules that differ confuse the clerk
Coverage: AC-1 to AC-8 by API (A1–A34), on the screen (W1–W9) and across both (I1–I6). Leaves out the portal, bills and load.
